notes.title: Build 1.0.90 Patch Notes
notes.content:
General bug fixes
 Added support for unselecting all selected cards via right mouse click (or RS press on controller)

notes.title: Build 1.0.89 Patch Notes
notes.content: Fixed endless mode/massive target score issue where relics like Helm of Salvation were setting target score to 0.

notes.title: Build 1.0.88 patch notes
notes.content:
[olist]
 Minor bug fixes
 Reworded some tooltips for clarity
 Fixed "Challenge Complete" achievement not being awarded bug
 New art for card backs, consistency between challenge and non-challenge decks now
 New card front, Vintage style
 New art for a handful of relics
 Fixed get Perfect Nailed It bonuses every hand once target scores exceed MAX_INT
 Changing SUIT, RANK and Doppelganging now count as Cardsmith Enhancements toward the Steam achievement
[/olist]

notes.title: Build 1.0.86 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Reworded some relic and potion tooltips for clarity
 Added some more Jinx snarky comments when run ends
 Fixed an issue of the store running out of perks, usually in endless mode

notes.title: Build 1.0.84 Patch Notes
notes.content: Final prep for full retail release!

notes.title: Build 0.9.82 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Trilogy of Luck now must be unlocked by buying The Lucky Perk 5 times
 3 more super relics added
 Faced mask got a buff
 Heavy Handed perk added
 Card swap potions now all flip the exchanged cards over
 Prodigal son no longer resets on starter, just main hand
 Memory leak on collections page fixed
 Fixed a couple of buttons that were not listening to theme changed events
 Made Vulture's Staff uncommon instead of rare
 Fixed some glitches in the home page animations
 "Select 1-1  cards" tooltip fixed on potions that affect cards
 Speed Run Counting off during Tutorial
 Tutorial oddities sorted and fixed
 Fixed some Steam deck focus ordering issues

notes.title: We Are Exiting Early Access!
notes.content:
After almost 3 months in early access, we are ready to officially launch Cribbish. A ton of content and features have been added in the past 90 days, not the least of which is:


 Infinite replayability — Every hand is a puzzle. Every run, a new strategy.
 Endless Mode
 Speed Running
 20+ different challenging decks to choose from
 4 different difficulties to choose from
 14 different card enhancements to power up the cards in your deck
 100+ relics, each with it's own unique ability to boost your game
 25+ potions to provide you with instant help when needed
 35+ perks that you can use to bend the rules in your favor or upgrade your relics/potions
 50+ brutal and elite challenges to stand in your way as you climb the peg board
 Over a dozen hidden easter eggs to discover

notes.title: Build 0.9.77 Patch Notes
notes.content: Polish and minor bug fixes in preparation for May 10th release

notes.title: Build 0.9.75 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
 Lyrebird and Lock & Key now display their chosen card
 Lock and Key now supports selecting just a card without a specific set
 Luck (via the perk) now plays a roll in how good of cards you get in the store
 There is a "Lucky" chance the store will offer cards with both a type and a bonus
 Polish and final prep work for launch
[/olist]

notes.title: Build 0.9.71 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fit and finish polishing
 Hovering over sold item now still show tooltip
 Super relics are now considered discovered when formed
 Super Relics now show up on the Collection page
 Fixed a bug in Chaos Essence duplicating the relic on the right
 Increased scoring ramps
 Horn of Plenty and Ring of Clarity now have associated permanence perks
 Adjusted the levelling ramps for set scores (via the perks that buff them up)
 Fixed a floating point bug that occassionally gave you a massive amount of points
 Scoring panel now shows fractional multipliers (ie. Card Mourner and its 0.25mx)
 Starter Swap Sarsaparilla potion has been added
 Bronze Scorpion got a little buff

notes.title: Build 0.9.68 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Made undiscovered items easier to see on the Collections page
 One more easter egg added
 Add a little extra challenge to Hard and Nightmare difficulties in addition to bigger target scores
 Reroll perk and Nibs perk now have better icons
 Added a new Steam Achievement

notes.title: Build 0.9.66 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Flattened the set levelling perks a little (Like the One Five perk or the Sprinter's perk)
 Added one more easter egg
 Fixed a save/load issue that one of the easter eggs introduced

notes.title: Build 0.9.65 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
A lot of new stuff here in this one.


 Handful of Easter eggs sprinkled about, some are just for fun and some spice up the game itself a little...
 The Glacial Ember relic has been added
 Kings Tithe is now taken up front before checking to see if level has been won
 Kings Tithe is no longer restored with KK is scored, instead a pair of KK prevents the tithe
 Made Lock and Key easier to match and scalable with the game
 The Book of Luck perk upgrade is meaningful now
 Clicking on sort by suit multiple times in a row will rotate the order of the suits in the sort
 Stats and Discoveries are now honored when playing a Challenge Deck
 Fixed Perilux card bug so nows there's a true 3% chance of it breaking
 The Lucky Perk has been added. Increase your luck and things will start going your way
 Perks that have a limited # uses now tell you that in their tooltip
 All base line potion and relic sell prices are the greater of $1 or half of purchase price
 Removed crib card count limit of 18 cards
 Added ability to abort counting and end the hand
 Added user stat tracking for speed running (best time per deck, per difficulty)
 Fixed an issue with the Tetraquark upgrade perks tooltip
 Steepened the Endless Mode scoring ramp
 Fixed unlock requirement tooltip for the Glacial Ember relic
 Added picture icons for the set perks instead of showing the cards of the hand

notes.title: Build 0.9.60 PATCH NOTES - Endless Mode is finally here!
notes.content:
Endless mode is enabled
 Speed Counting has now been enabled (see the Settings page)
 The Item Shopper Perk has been added (+1 item choices in the shop)
 The store now guarantees a balance of relics/potions/perks
 Rank Demotion is now available in the Cardsmith
 Perks that level up set scores (One Five Perk, Suitor's Perk, etc...) now ramp more aggressively
 Various bug fixes and polish items
 Relevant potions are now drinkable in the Cardsmith
 Eye of Ghormech retooled to scale better

notes.title: Build 0.9.58 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Tetraquark relic added (and the perks to upgrade it)
 Crib Card Cider potion added
 Perlix Potion added
 Shufflate Shandy added
 Camouflauge Cocktail added
 Obsidian Oathbind added
 Draft of Discard as been bumped up to 10pts per discard
 Horn of Empty removed from the game
 Dream catcher removed from the game
 Rocketship gives out + multiplier now instead of + pts
 Gift of Giving is now the Cash Back Wallet
 Traders token now increases $1 per brute & elite challenges beaten
 Killing Time now adds an addition 60s per level instead of starting at 60s every level

notes.title: Build 0.9.55 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
New card types and bonuses! Plus a lot of other goodies in this larger than normal update.


 Rank bonus has been upgraded to give more points and in a different manner
 Steel cards have been upgraded to give more points and in a different manner
 Chaos Essence has been upgraded to be more positive and useful
 Ruby Bonus Enhancer perk has been removed and replaced with Rank Bonus Enhancer perk
 Obdisian card enhancement type has been added
 Camouflage card enhancement type has been added
 Shufflate card bonus has been added
 Perilux card bonus has been added
 Added new potion: The Painkiller
 Added new potion: Crib Stash Smash
 Added a handful of new Brute and Elite challenges to keep everyone on their toes
 Added 2 new Steam Achievements, one hidden and one public
 Stats now properly captured when a game NaN's out
 Shop now turns prices tags RED when you can't afford something
 Crib cards now apply their effect after Lyrebird applies it's effect
 Fixed issue with Best Medicine only giving its bonus when a potion is drank
 Fixed an issue that was causing Crib Cards to trigger in the main hand as well

notes.title: Build 0.9.53 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Ludicrous Speed counting is now in place (for long running hand counts that take hours to count)
 Keyboard text entry for run seed no longer keeps resetting cursor back to beginning
 Deck quick peek had hearts and spades flipped. Fixed now
 6's and A's challenge was not blocking Aces, it does now
 Controller drift no longer flips UI into controller mode. You must press a button now
 Reveal perk is remembered now and doesn't reset
 Cribbin' It deck no longer crashes after counting the first hand
 You can now reset your all time best hand scores (Best Main, Crib and Full hands)
 Fixed a memory leak that was causing really long counting hands to crash
 Potion of Haste no longer auto-starts the counting process, it just reduces cards required to be sent to crib to 0
 Convert all hands into draws challenge no longer shows up when playing The Stud deck

notes.title: BUILD 0.9.50 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
UI Polish and game speed tuning
 General bug fixes

notes.title: BUILD 0.9.49 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Fixed multiplier bugs working on crib and main hand
 Added in new Level Rewards system (it's functional, but UI and animation are still a WIP)
 Best Medicine got an upgrade so it's useful now
 Fallen Star got an upgrade so it's useful up to mid-run now
 Challenge Ribbons now remove themselves when switching to next deck
 Adjusted card animation speeds so it's not painfully slow when the counting is slowed
 Made the new Counting Panel a toggle on/off panel attached to RT and TAB
 2 new decks added (Til Death and The Count)

notes.title: Build 0.9.47 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Fixed bug where multipliers were not be applied correctly
 Cards now heat up during counting like relics
 Fixed a couple pieces of text that didn't match the Light Theme

notes.title: Build 0.9.46 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
New Dark Theme
 New hand counting visualization panel
 The Big Saver achievement now works as advertised
 Fixed issue of selling a potion on Steam deck causing crash

notes.title: Build 0.9.43 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Eliminated bosses that 'remove cards from deck'
 Added in some new bosses to take their place
 Update pegboard visuals
 Relic Slots now 'heat up' when they trigger frequently
 Added some new settings to turn off some of the games features (like screen shake and Jinx Snarkiness)
 Moved the seed input to the left so steam deck users can get from deck selection to start button directly
 4 new achievements added to Steam (Hand Solo, Big Deck 90, Finest Suit and Luckiest Number)
 Quick Restart menu item added to option wheel menu
 Free badge no longer covers the real price
 Cardsmith action buttons no longer grey out when invalid # of cards are selected
 Mult bonus cards are now stack linearly instead of exponentially
 Mult bonus cards can now be perk enhanced 3 times instead of just once

notes.title: 0.9.41 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
General UI clean up and polish
 Made the jump from Apprentice deck to Gunslinger deck a bit smaller (Gunslinger deck got a little easier)
 Hearts on Ruby cards are now more readable
 Card bonuses now fully visible even on Classic deck
 Restored the ability to reactivate the Jinx tutorial 
 Are you sure? prompt now protects selling potions and relics during play
 Mask of Secrets now gives +5pt per card used when making a 15

notes.title: RELEASE 0.9.40 NOTES
notes.content:
Fairly big set of new features and bug fixes:

 Update to lastest version of game engine
 Run stats and Common Terminology now displayed on Scoring Info page
 Quick deck view now also show card type counts (emerald, ruby, steel, etc...)
 Quick deck view now shows up when either shift key is pressed, not just the left
 New Game Over panel
 New Victory Panel
 Both Game Over and Victory screens now allow you to continue seeing your relics, your deck and full run stats
 Jinx now matches the theme better
 Fixed No kids under 6 deck still selling A-5 in the item shop
 2 New Deck styles - Classic and The Misfits
 New potions - Potion of Haste
 New Relic - The Count
 Casual difficulty now gives +$1 in win rewards instead of -$1 on all shop items
 Win rewards are now $4 and $6 (elite) to give a little more money in the early rounds
 Adjusted the scoring ramps to be a little easier in the beginning and a little harder at the end
 Prodigal son now get his increments before counting, not after

notes.title: 0.9.37 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
The Settings page now has a card style picker and supports multiple styles of face cards
 You can now see your active perks in the scoring info panel
 Enabled tooltip viewing during hand counting (experimental)
 Buying upgrade perk that makes a relics effect permanent, the relic itself no longer show up in the item shop
 Casual, Easy and Standard difficulties now start with 5 cards in the shop instead of 4
 Buying the The Card Shoppers Perk now gives you that extra card on your next Reroll

notes.title: 0.9.35 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Fixed the rest of the Main hand/crib hand colorized texts
 Fixed being able to double click on the Rank Up action in Cardsmith while animation is playing and get an extra rank up
 Card Collector and Card Mourner now give their +1 multiplier immediately and do not wait for the first card to be added/removed from the deck
 Increased chance of economy relics & perks appearing in the store by 15% in the first 3 levels
 The shop now only offers 3 cards for purchase by default
 Added the Card Shopper perk that adds an additional card for sale in the shop
 Challenge decks now have their own dedicated ribbon
 Increased contrast on item tooltips to improve readability
 Toggling "Share aggregated statistics" no longer puts you into windowed mode
 Fixed rainbow cards continuing their rainbow effect after being purchased in shop
 Fixed challenge ribbon being left on screen when scrolling through decks on start run page
 Beating a challenge deck now gives you the Steam achievement
 Tracked down random main hand card being face down bug
 Fixed crashing bug in the View Deck page
 Fixed potion buy back price always at $1

notes.title: 0.9.33 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Made tooltip on The One Ring clearer as to what the relic does
 Deck Selector now tracks your current progress towards beating the deck/difficulty
 Deck selector now shows all the difficulties you've beaten as ribbons on the deck itself
 The Poker Mania deck no longer gives you the impossible challenge of getting 4 Fifteens
 Added some color coding to MAIN HAND and THE CRIB wording in relic tooltips for faster comprehension
 Lyrebird now works correctly when the crib is being counted
 Eye of Ghormech now functions correctly, even in the Revolution deck
 Put in some temporary artwork for face cards to see how people like having real face cards again

notes.title: 0.9.32 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Lyrebird is now limited to cloning at most 3 cards
 Fixed relics creeping up the screen when counting at max speed
 Fixed Cardsmith button not enabling when a relic is sold for coins
 Fixed Cardsmith "Remove Card" perk from carry over to next run
 Fixed view deck page to look nicer when you have more than 30 cards in one suit

notes.title: 0.9.31 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Maternal Crib now gives +2 mult PER queen and activates before counting starts
 Emerald cards now give their multiplier at the beginning of the hand
 Crib cards now give their multiplier at the beginning of crib counting
 Fixed re-triggering of gold cards when Gold Mine relic is in play
 Fixed level 8.3 occasionally not being assigned a Brute Challenge, making level impossible to pass
 Consolation Prize tooltip updated to reflect that the Draw counter will not be decremented
 Fixed Veil of Seraphis issue where the prices in the shop always show $0, even after the free one
 Fixed issue with Meteor Storm giving out massive multipliers
 Cleaned up Prodigal Son tooltip so it's easier to understand how it works

notes.title: 0.9.30 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Added tooltips for the 2 sorting buttons
Fixed phrasings in several of the relics
Undiscovered items no longer show their Name when in the Store
When Steam Achievement API calls fail, we now cache and retry on next app launch
Game handles player running out of cards in a more graceful manner now

notes.title: 0.9.28 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Traveller's Clasp now gives you an extra card when activated
Fixed tooltip positioning issues on the View Deck page
Corrected typos in various relic tooltips
The Frugal Perk now gives the proper amount of coins
Fixed Vampire's Ring tooltip to be more readable against background
Rapid selecting/deselecting/dragging of card in main hand no longer leaves them slightly askew
